title: What Can $11 Million Buy? — dramatized figures, portrait
description: Instagram portrait. Title and tagline over the huge red $11,077,173 (“spent opposing him”) and small green $323,426 (“spent supporting him”), noted as a 34:1 gap.
alt_text: Portrait graphic: “What Can $11 Million Buy? It just might have bought the derailment of a people-powered movement.” A giant red $11,077,173 labeled spent opposing him; below it a small green $323,426 labeled spent supporting him — a 34 to 1 gap.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
